orders_amounts_check.name: orders_amounts_check

orders_status_timestamps_check.name: orders_status_timestamps_check
orders_status_timestamps_check.value: ("orders"."status" = 'paid_awaiting_tenant' and "orders"."confirmed_at" is null and "orders"."preparing_at" is null and "orders"."ready_at" is null and "orders"."completed_at" is null) or ("orders"."status" in ('confirmed', 'preparing', 'ready_for_pickup') and "orders"."confirmed_at" is not null and "orders"."paid_at" is not null) or ("orders"."status" = 'completed' and "orders"."confirmed_at" is not null and "orders"."paid_at" is not null and "orders"."ready_at" is not null and "orders"."completed_at" is not null) or ("orders"."status" = 'cancelled' and "orders"."cancelled_at" is not null) or ("orders"."status" = 'declined' and "orders"."declined_at" is not null)

refunds_succeeded_check.name: refunds_succeeded_check
refunds_succeeded_check.value: ("refunds"."status" = 'succeeded' and "refunds"."succeeded_at" is not null and "refunds"."ledger_transaction_id" is not null) or ("refunds"."status" <> 'succeeded' and "refunds"."succeeded_at" is null and "refunds"."ledger_transaction_id" is null)

refunds_failed_check.name: refunds_failed_check
refunds_failed_check.value: ("refunds"."status" = 'failed' and "refunds"."failed_at" is not null) or ("refunds"."status" <> 'failed' and "refunds"."failed_at" is null)

settlements_status_timestamps_check.name: settlements_status_timestamps_check
settlements_status_timestamps_check.value:
("settlements"."status" = 'pending' and "settlements"."released_at" is null and "settlements"."release_ledger_transaction_id" is null and "settlements"."paid_out_minor" = 0)
        or ("settlements"."status" = 'available' and "settlements"."released_at" is not null and "settlements"."release_ledger_transaction_id" is not null and "settlements"."paid_out_minor" < "settlements"."amount_minor")
        or ("settlements"."status" = 'paid_out' and "settlements"."released_at" is not null and "settlements"."release_ledger_transaction_id" is not null and "settlements"."paid_out_minor" = "settlements"."amount_minor")
        or ("settlements"."status" = 'voided' and "settlements"."voided_at" is not null and "settlements"."paid_out_minor" = 0)
        or ("settlements"."status" = 'reversed' and "settlements"."reversed_at" is not null and "settlements"."paid_out_minor" = 0)

bank_accounts_verification_check.name: bank_accounts_verification_check
bank_accounts_verification_check.value:
("bank_accounts"."verification_status" = 'verified' and "bank_accounts"."verified_at" is not null and "bank_accounts"."verified_by_user_id" is not null and "bank_accounts"."verification_method" is not null)
        or ("bank_accounts"."verification_status" <> 'verified' and "bank_accounts"."verified_at" is null and "bank_accounts"."verified_by_user_id" is null and "bank_accounts"."verification_method" is null)

payout_attempts_finished_check.name: payout_attempts_finished_check

payout_events_actor_check.name: payout_events_actor_check

payouts_ledger_legs_check.name: payouts_ledger_legs_check
payouts_ledger_legs_check.value:
"payouts"."hold_ledger_transaction_id" is not null
        and (("payouts"."status" = 'succeeded' and "payouts"."settle_ledger_transaction_id" is not null and "payouts"."release_ledger_transaction_id" is null)
          or ("payouts"."status" in ('failed','cancelled') and "payouts"."settle_ledger_transaction_id" is null and "payouts"."release_ledger_transaction_id" is not null)
          or ("payouts"."status" in ('requested','processing') and "payouts"."settle_ledger_transaction_id" is null and "payouts"."release_ledger_transaction_id" is null))

payouts_timestamps_check.name: payouts_timestamps_check
payouts_timestamps_check.value:
("payouts"."status" = 'requested' and "payouts"."processing_at" is null and "payouts"."succeeded_at" is null and "payouts"."failed_at" is null and "payouts"."cancelled_at" is null)
        or ("payouts"."status" = 'processing' and "payouts"."processing_at" is not null and "payouts"."succeeded_at" is null and "payouts"."failed_at" is null and "payouts"."cancelled_at" is null)
        or ("payouts"."status" = 'succeeded' and "payouts"."succeeded_at" is not null and "payouts"."failed_at" is null and "payouts"."cancelled_at" is null)
        or ("payouts"."status" = 'failed' and "payouts"."failed_at" is not null and "payouts"."succeeded_at" is null and "payouts"."cancelled_at" is null)
        or ("payouts"."status" = 'cancelled' and "payouts"."cancelled_at" is not null and "payouts"."succeeded_at" is null and "payouts"."failed_at" is null)
